main.description: A signed checkpoint of the PDS audit log, published in the operator's own repository so relays and mirrors witness it. See docs/rust/SPEC.md section 20.

server.description: Service DID of the PDS that wrote the log.

firstSeq.description: First audit entry sequence number covered by this checkpoint.

lastSeq.description: Last audit entry sequence number covered by this checkpoint.

treeSize.description: Total number of entries in the log at this checkpoint.

root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root over the entries since the previous checkpoint.

previousRoot.description: Root of the previous checkpoint, or 32 zero bytes for the first.

chainHash.description: Hash of the last entry's chain link at this checkpoint.

keyId.description: Identifier of the Ed25519 key that signed this checkpoint.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical checkpoint body.
